attempts.sql:
WITH connector_classes AS (
  SELECT s.symbol_id AS class_symbol_id
  FROM code.symbols s
  JOIN code.files f ON s.file_id = f.file_id
  WHERE s.kind = 'class'
    AND f.file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/connectors/base.py'
    AND f.is_test = FALSE
    AND s.qualname LIKE 'SQLDatabase.%'
),
connector_methods AS (
  SELECT s.symbol_id AS class_symbol_id, s.name AS method_name
  FROM code.symbols s
  WHERE s.kind = 'function'
    AND s.is_public = TRUE
    AND s.name NOT LIKE '_%'
),
connector_method_own AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cm.class_symbol_id, cm.method_name
  FROM connector_methods cm
  JOIN connector_classes cc ON cm.class_symbol_id = cc.class_symbol_id
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM code.calls c
    WHERE c.caller_symbol_id = cc.class_symbol_id
      AND c.callee_symbol_id = cm.symbol_id
  )
)
SELECT class_symbol_id, method_name
FROM connector_method_own
ORDER BY class_symbol_id, method_name;

request:
The production database connectors are the classes that directly subclass SQLDatabase (defined in auto_ontology/connectors/base.py), excluding any class defined in test code (every file under a tests/ folder counts as test code). For each such connector class, which public methods does the class define in its own body that SQLDatabase itself does not define? A method is public when its name does not start with an underscore (so __init__ and other dunder methods are excluded); anything written with def directly in the class body counts as a method, including properties and context-manager methods. Methods inherited without being redefined do not count. Return one row per (connector class symbol ID, method name).

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string), method_name (string).
explanation: The corrected query uses cc.symbol_id (the actual column from connector_classes) to join with cm.symbol_id, fixing the missing column reference. It identifies connector classes that subclass SQLDatabase in the non-test base file, then finds public methods defined in those classes by checking for direct call sites from the class body.

WITH connector_classes AS (
  SELECT s.symbol_id
  FROM code.symbols s
  JOIN code.files f ON s.file_id = f.file_id
  WHERE s.kind = 'class'
    AND f.file_id = 'auto_ontology/connectors/base.py'
    AND f.is_test = FALSE
    AND s.qualname LIKE 'SQLDatabase.%'
),
connector_methods AS (
  SELECT s.symbol_id, s.name AS method_name
  FROM code.symbols s
  WHERE s.kind = 'function'
    AND s.is_public = TRUE
    AND s.name NOT LIKE '_%'
),
connector_method_own AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cm.symbol_id AS class_symbol_id, cm.method_name
  FROM connector_methods cm
  JOIN connector_classes cc ON cm.symbol_id = cc.symbol_id
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM code.calls c
    WHERE c.caller_symbol_id = cc.symbol_id
      AND c.callee_symbol_id = cm.symbol_id

FROM connector_method_own
ORDER BY class_symbol_id, method_name;
